title: TaskThreads & Persistent Memory,
Traceable Long-Horizon Execution.
diagnostics.description: Decouples task orchestration, model gateway, and shared memory layers to ensure production reliability, complete data sovereignty, and full-stack observability.

Seamless Client Association: XWorkmate client functions as the frontend UI, connecting to local or cloud Workspaces with one click
